notes.title: RTX Beta Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31019141/98bd9afacbe4653391af464d0c06ebe9a490abcc.gif[/img]

[b][i][h3]Champions (with graphical processing to spare) you've been waiting for THIS.[/h3][/i][/b]
Our [b]FINAL[/b] round of [i]RTX beta testing[/i] has [b]BEGUN[/b].

After nearly a [b]YEAR[/b] since we first put ray tracing features into the game, we're almost ready for [i][b]FULL LAUNCH[/b][/i] thanks to our friends at [url=https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/geforce/]Nvidia[/url]. 

[b]Before you hop in, we highly recommend you grab [url=https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/geforce/drivers/]the latest drivers from the GeForce website![/url][/b]

But not before we get [u]one more[/u] round of feedback and testing from [b]YOU[/b].

[i][h3]So what can you expect?![/h3][/i]
[b][u]Accurate enemy shadows[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31019141/be799caf948a75898d3d276a711cae156ea21d2a.gif[/img]

[u][b]Fully accurate reflections[/b][/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31019141/45815610ae06679625eaf7111d0026da3663f3af.gif[/img]

[u][b]Pixel perfect geometry shadows[/b][/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31019141/91fa54b5e94a18441b86a292c7f0386b3e95f5a4.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31019141/7d2f9d0c0513cf84393f41daeedca5888d11161c.gif[/img]

[i][h3]So what do we want you to test?[/h3][/i][olist]

[*] Can you get the game to [b]CRASH?![/b] If so, how! Reproduce those steps and send them to us!

[*] Are there any areas where you get MEGA performance drops? Not normal perf drops due to an abundance of lights and shadows and enemies (that will happen) but places where performance just seems... [b]WRONG[/b].

[*] New [b]BUGS[/b]! Do you get any issues with levels or enemies that aren't present in the base game? Let us know so we can fix them!
[/olist]
[i][b]You can get on the RTX Beta testing branch by selecting it from the BETAS tab in game properties![/b][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31019141/137b96759e5821e1e84746d230cc4081e0fc0fec.png[/img]

[i][b][h3]Now, I know what some of you are saying.[/h3][/b][/i]
[i]"Voice of the Ancients! (or Dave) I don't have an RTX GPU!"[/i]

"I just want to know more about... [i][b]THE BLACK LABYRINTH"[/b][/i],

And don't forget to keep up with [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/673130/discussions/0/3099012755258753482/]our #ScreenshotSaturday development posts[/url] (almost) every week!

notes.title: The End Draws Near...
notes.content:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/jRYiBl0Lxv3H1jdr8i/giphy.gif[/img]
[i][b]Champions![/b][/i]

[h1][b]The seventh and final episode of [i]AMID EVIL[/i] is nearly upon us.[/b][/h1]

[i]You've already had your first look at The Void...[/i]
https://steamcommunity.com/games/673130/announcements/detail/1636405987619998841 [i]But that's not all we've been working on as we come toward the finale of your journey...[/i]

[h1]You may have noticed we've recently started updating [i]previous [/i]episodes of [i]AMID EVIL[/i][/h1]

[b]Episode 3: The Sacred Path just received a major overhaul that added several tweaks...
[list]
[*] NEW lore
[*] NEW enemies
[*]NEW gameplay elements
[*] and more...[/b][img]https://media.giphy.com/media/gj5tB03Cod5vAh8KuQ/giphy.gif[/img]

[b]We believe the increased enemy variety along with more situational use of your arsenal against them...[/b]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/YqbxPGoMYIm9IHbgmY/giphy.gif[/img]

[b]Makes for an overall stronger experience - something we're going to be bringing to other episodes as well![/b]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/Q86wx6jMHD0p3mU5EY/giphy.gif[/img]

One of the few complaints we've received during Early Access is that weapons don't feel situational enough in certain scenarios or against certain enemy types. [i]And while that's not entirely true[/i] - we're going to be going back and updating the levels so that certain enemies and scenarios are [b]definitely[/b] appropriate for distinct weapons.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/9uJ40d1vQ7ZnmyuMwN/giphy.gif[/img]

You'll already notice that in Episode 3, explosive weapons now destroy rock enemies easily, the water staff [i]douses[/i] fire enemies, the axe rips through plant life and the trident electrifies underwater enemies (because that all kind of makes sense!)

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/9RXF64Mp2RxwwTC9bg/giphy.gif[/img]

We'll be making these sort of changes to each episode so keep an eye out - and when in doubt - [b]USE THE AXE OF THE BLACK LABYRINTH.[/b] (it's not just some weak default axe, okay?)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31019141/20ffbd676d220da2b64c39bb1f81f4f8a9c7716b.jpg[/img]

[i][b]But I digress...[/b][/i]

We've also been adding more story, lore and environmental storytelling to the game. And [i]not JUST new voice overs, and not JUST new lore[/i] written on the walls...

[h1][b]The gateway will now change depending on what episode you've finished.[/b][/h1]

[i]You may now notice the night stars will come out after defeating the Moon Guardian of Episode 1[/i]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31019141/5ce15ec8a7a71800d58fd550f57e4428a7f81760.jpg[/img]

[i]Or it's now a foggy afternoon as you head toward Episode 3[/i]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31019141/e415377159eb4291e2ac55b3d28f146e9172628d.jpg[/img]

[i]Or it's become dark as midnight after defeating the Solar Saint of Episode 4[/i]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31019141/33821346eae072460679ed5ebc4a5ae58bdeb1f2.jpg[/img]

[i]Or that something seems [i]EVIL[/i] as you prepare to enter The Void...[/i]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31019141/1d70b8be12fb95b310f29fd4029d166a424282c0.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31019141/4f3c5f7fa903b44d8ecbfba392e933716e0138ad.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31019141/efcdc7474666e78877d29b2844459c40ac676e27.jpg[/img]

What we're aiming to do with this is create a continuously engaging and varied experience throughout these [b]seven[/b] distinct worlds as you're guided along by the Voice of the Ancients in order to defeat this cursed evil and save their lands...

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/KyBcPBSx60geXKmuq4/giphy.gif[/img]

[i]Speaking of the voice of the Ancients: please give a virtual round of applause to our VA, Tamara Ryan - she's been incredible to work with and you should hire her to work on your projects, too! http://www.tamararyanvo.com/[/i]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/UReRvDH11BY0sUlJLn/giphy.gif[/img]

https://twitter.com/DaveOshry/status/1131397726334095360

[b]Thank you[/b] to everyone who've helped us build [i]AMID EVIL[/i] into the game it is today! And thank you to everyone who has spread the good word of New Blood! Thanks to [b]you[/b], AMID EVIL is now [i][b]the highest rated FPS on Steam.[/b][/i] Now it's time to finish off this evil once and for all...

[i][h1][b]The end draws near, champions... are you prepared?![/b][/h1][/i]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31019141/5a438c33fc867d6300e1d447825d0157faf1cbef.jpg[/img]

notes.title: AMID Update #4
notes.content:
[img]https://thumbs.gfycat.com/AbleVagueAssassinbug-size_restricted.gif[/img]
[h1][b][i]Welcome back, Champions![/i][/b][/h1] 

We hope you've survived [i]The Solar Solstice[/i], because more trials await you... and you can partake in them... [b]RIGHT NOW.[/b]

That's right, [u]Update #4[/u] brings with it a brand new [i]Hordes of Evil[/i] arena as well as a new hub world for [i]Hordes of Evil.[/i]

[i]It's big. It's purple. It's got dank ambient music... you'll dig it.[/i]

[i]Hordes of Evil[/i] arenas will now also feature enemies from [b]ALL FOUR[/b] available episodes. So prepare thy butts.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/TIiBXyM504flozqmS6/giphy.gif[/img]

But more importantly...

[h1][b]This new update has completely revamped the enemy AI[/b][/h1]

You'll find enemies will now be less aggressive but more tactical. 
You'll notice more strafing, side stepping, backpedaling and ranged attacks. 

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/OOSJGpnqWOM6VtJI94/giphy.gif[/img]

You'll especially start to see ranged enemies use new attack patterns and in general most combat encounters in the game will now feel much more dynamic and varied. 
Not to mention (potentially) more difficult.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/Bzkoa3SuI6HN2u4BDj/giphy.gif[/img]

This AI change makes the game feel A LOT different, and [b]we think you're gonna like it.[/b]

[h1][i]We've also made significant changes to the enemies and weapons you encounter Episode 3 - so go replay it! We think you'll appreciate those changes as well[/i][/h1]

Hmm, but there was something else...

Oh yeah, [b]YOU CAN NOW REBIND SOUL MODE AND FIRE IT INDEPENDENTLY. 
THAT'S RIGHT. WE GAVE IN TO YOUR DEMANDS. 
DON'T SAY WE NEVER DID ANYTHING FOR YOU![/b]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/20yCpxzLFZaawO3Zgt/giphy.gif[/img]
[i]Note: this is not how the game was intended to be played - but we're all for options.[/i]

Full patch notes HERE: https://steamcommunity.com/app/673130/discussions/0/2949168687311359737/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/673130/AMID_EVIL/

As always, don't forget to drop into Discord.gg/NewBlood to chat with us and keep up to date on all the latest - and also check out our brand new developer page to see what's up with ALL of our games as well as our latest recommendations.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/9P95y3adOB6kSRDnrh/giphy.gif[/img]
[i][b]Warriors! We've just released the [u]third[/u] update for AMID EVIL![/b][/i]

[h1]Changes include...[/h1]
[list]
[*]An upgrade to Unreal Engine 4.19 (we didn't break anything!)
[*]Flight mode less slippery (like an eagle)
[*]Insta death torches fixed (sorry)
[*]Apostle's Shrine lift bug fixed (no squish)
[*]Weapon switch while firing is now a thing (you're welcome)
[*]Getting out of water is now easier (you're very welcome)
[*]Hordes of Evil end score now front and center (haha u ded)
[*]New water death for Azure Orb overkill (they'll float too)
[*]Flying enemy AI won't get in your face (t'was broken)
[*]More souls required for Hard and Evil, less souls required for Easy (good balance)
[*]Holding fire won't activate soul mode 'til your next fire (no more accidents!)
[/list]
The quality of life improvements such as the soul changes, new flying AI and NOT being able to accidentally trigger soul mode (it happens to thhe best of us) [i]really[/i] change the way the game feels at its core - we think you'll dig it!

But we couldn't keep improving and tweaking [i]AMID EVIL[/i] without your feedback so... 

[i]KEEP. IT. COMING.[/i]

[h1]Until next time, warriors...[/h1]

[i][b]Warriors! We've just released the first update for AMID EVIL![/b][/i]

[h1]Changes include...[/h1]
[list]
[*] New Planets for the Celestial Claw
[*] Planets randomize a lot nicer now, you won't get the same planet twice.
[*] Earth shows up less frequently, so you can commit genocide LESS.
[*] Voltride casts [b]Chain Lightning[/b] on overkill now. (also a cool Steely Dan song)
[*] Frame cap slider can now go to UNLIMITED (power!!!!)
[*] Weapon keys can be rebound.
[*] Reset to default should actually do something.
[*] Can change HUD message size in HUD options.
[*] Mana numbers on the HUD gotta go fast now instead of slow
[*] Asynchronous saving added so speedrunners won't get angry at me. (no hitches on saving).
[*] Axe does 5 MORE DAMAGE, yay. (this will actually 1 shot many enemies) 
[*] Sword projectile does more damage on direct hit. Pass thru damage is the same.
[*] Some enemies will enter their pain state (flinch) more often.
[*] Achievements should activate when you get level awards. 
[/list]
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/93fnnPlTgFFzSWybCE/giphy.gif[/img]
[i]Oh and the Axe of the Black Labyrinth now ACTUALLY works as a boat propeller[/i]
